subject: Hausa
sourceFile: Copy of Hausa BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG.txt
examFormat: Derived from the 9-year Basic Education Curriculum, the syllabus has two parts: L1 (Hausa as mother tongue or language of the immediate environment) and L2 (Hausa as a second language). L1 candidates should express themselves in appropriate Hausa, know Hausa oral tradition, read and appreciate Hausa literature and write with correct grammar, idioms, orthography and punctuation; L2 candidates should understand and express themselves in common Hausa and listen, read and interact with Hausa people. L1 has two 1-hour papers: Paper 1 is 60 multiple-choice questions on comprehension (10), composition (5), grammar (25), sound system (10), orthography (5) and translation (5); Paper 2 is 60 questions on oral literature (15), written literature (25) and culture/tradition (20). L2 is one 1-hour paper of 60 multiple-choice questions: written comprehension (10), dialogue/conversation (10), numbers, greetings, alphabet, translation, grammar and culture (25), and pictorial identification of time, the human body, animals, crops/vegetables and domestic utensils (15).
excluded: syllabus.ng 'About us', 'About BECE', eligibility, grading, registration and FAQ chapters. The L1 and L2 syllabuses are combined in this one file; L2 topic names are suffixed '(L2)'. The L1 literature theme heading was missing in the extraction and is taken as 'Adabi' (as in L2). The extraction lost Hausa hooked letters (ɓ, ɗ, ƙ, 'y) and garbled many words; text is written in plain orthography and OCR errors corrected where the reading was clear (e.g. 'Gab0bin' → 'Gabobin', 'kucfi' → 'kudi', 'Ilaba-haba' → 'haba-haba'). Uncertain readings: the organs of speech list ('Hanka', 'Hancfa' read as 'hanci'), 'etra da gursimeti' and the insha'i type 'na tadillira' (kept as printed), L2 topic 'Nema alfarma da tuyar da' (cut off; given as 'Neman alfarma'), and the poetry anthology 'Alkalami A Hannun' by 'Gwararn H.' (title and author possibly truncated/garbled, kept as printed). Repeated L1 theme headings ('Ginshikin ginin al'umma', 'Dabi'u da al'adu') are qualified by their first content item.
recommendedTexts: Alkalami A Hannun (poetry) — Gwararn H. et al. (NNPC)
Sabuwar Hanyar Nazarin Hausa 1-3 (supplementary, L1) — Zarruk M.R. et al.
Hausa Don Kananan Makarantun Sakandare 1-3 (supplementary, L1) — Galadanci M.K.M. et al. (Longman Nigeria)

topics.name: Ginshikin ginin al'umma: dabarun tafiyar da rayuwa
objectives: Rikon sana'a da dabarunsa: kyautata sana'a, kawo sabon salo, tsafta, cika alkawari, gaskiya, aiki tukuru, alfahari da sana'a
Rike iyali da dabarunsa: rikon amana, tabbatar da tarbiyya, biyan bukatu muhimmai, gaskiya, kyautata dangantaka da cusa soyayya a tsakanin iyali, makwabtaka ta gari
Tattalin kudi da dabarunsa: tsara yadda ake kashe su, kauce wa almubazzaranci, ajiya a banki, ware kudi domin bukatun gida, kiyaye daukar kudi masu yawa
Cudanya da zamantakewa da dabarunsu: sanin hakkin mutane, tsare mutunci, akidar rayuwa ta gari, samar wa kai kwarjini, zumunci, haba-haba, taimako da hadin kai

topics.name: Ginshikin ginin al'umma: sana'o'in Hausawa
objectives: Ma'anar sana'a
Muhimmancin sana'a, misali dogaro da kai, kare mutunci, samun abin masarufi, hana zaman banza, samar da aiki, koyar da sana'a, habaka tattalin arziki, kyautata hulda da juna
Ire-iren sana'o'i: noma da kiwo, aski da kitso, rini, etra da gursimeti, dukanci, gini, walda, kafinta, kanikanci, zayyana, zanen kwarya, dinki

topics.name: Dabi'u da al'adu: miyagun kwayoyi
objectives: Ma'anar miyagun kwayoyi
Illar shan miyagun kwayoyi
Bayanin miyagun kwayoyi: wiwi, giya, sholisho
Bayanin magunguna masu amfani amma idan an wuce ka'ida su zama illa, misali baliyan, penagan, aji garau
Bayanin illolin shan miyagun kwayoyi da wadanda aka wuce ka'ida: hauka, lalata rayuwa, cututtuka, fita daga cikin jama'a, kadaitaka, kisa

topics.name: Sauye-sauyen da suka shafi al'adu
objectives: Ma'anar sauyin al'adu
Bayanin sauye-sauyen al'adu
Sauye-sauyen al'adu game da: fannin ilmi, cinikayya da kasuwanci, sana'o'i da sababbin sana'o'i na zamani kamar noma da abinci, bukukuwa, tufafi, zamantakewa, sarauta

topics.name: Bukukuwan gargajiya

Muhimmancin bukukuwa

topics.name: Kayayyakin al'adu
objectives: Zane da kwalliya da tufafin Hausawa
Zane na kwarya, na tukunya, na gida (dagi, makuba), na tufafi (kwado-da-linzami, sirfani, kufta, alkyabba, abaya)
Bayanin zane na kwarya, na tukunya, na gida da na tufa
Ire-iren tufafin Hausawa
Rukunan mutane dangane da amfani da tufafi

topics.name: Dabi'u da al'adu: ibada
objectives: Ma'anar ibada
Ire-iren ayyukan ibada: sallah, azumi, zakka, haji/ziyara, sada zumunci, sadaka, kyauta, tarbiyya, mu'amala
Muhimmancin ibada, misali karfafa imani, kyautata mu'amala, samun tarbiyya, aikata ayyuka nagari, kauce wa miyagun ayyuka, gina al'umma ta gari

topics.name: Ginshikin ginin al'umma: shugabanci
objectives: Ma'anar shugabanci
Ire-iren shugabanci: na gida, na gari, na kasa, na addini, na sana'a, na gwamnati (matakai), na karamar hukuma, jiha da kasa
Muhimmancin shugabanci, misali jagoranci, gudanar da mulki, tabbatar da bin doka, adalci da zaman lafiya, ci-gaban al'umma, girmama juna, tsaro (tsaron lafiya, kasa da dukiya)
Hawa uku na mulki: bangaren zartarwa, bangaren dokoki (majalisa), bangaren shari'a

topics.name: Hanyoyin samar da arziki
objectives: Ma'anar hanyoyin samar da arziki

Hanyoyin samar da arziki: kiwon zamani (dabbobi - tumaki, awaki, shanu, zomo; tsuntsaye - kaji, jimina, agwagwa, dinya; kifi), noman lambu da 'ya'yan itace, sarrafa kayan abinci, sana'o'in hannu kamar gyaran wayar hannu, kananan kere-kere ko ayyukan sadarwa na komfuta
Cinikayyar zamani: safarar kaya a gida da ketare, sayen hannun jari, hadin gwiwa, kafa kamfani
Bayanin jerin hanyoyin samar da arziki

topics.name: Dabi'u da al'adu: tsaro
objectives: Ma'anar tsaro
Nau'o'in tsaro: na kai, na gida, na harkar mu'amala, na gari, na kasa, da bayaninsu
Hukumomin tsaro: 'yan sanda, sojoji (kasa, ruwa, sama), kwastan, jami'an shige-da-fice, jami'an asiri, jami'an kurkuku

Shawarwari game da tsaro: sa fitilu, sa kofofi da tagogi masu inganci, ajiye kudi a banki, abokai na gari, tsantseni wajen karbar rance a banki, sirrin bayanan kai, kai rahoton miyagun ayyuka ga 'yan sanda, guje wa wani kunshi a hanya, sa ido kan baki
